main.description: A named, public dive site: a centre and a radius that consenting athletes' dives are matched to by their entry position (dive-sites/site-visits). Public: stored only in its creator's repo, never in a space; the AppView ignores a copy found in any space. The AppView indexes it only when its name is valid, its centre is a valid position and its radius is 25 to 500 m. Athletes' sites are keyed by TID; the segment importer's are keyed by the id of the extracted site they were published from.

radius.description: Meters: a dive whose entry lies within it may visit the site.

source.description: Where the site came from: an athlete's dive, OpenStreetMap or a public agency's dataset. A site whose source the AppView doesn't know isn't indexed.

license.description: The licence of the site's data, as an SPDX identifier such as CC0-1.0 or ODbL-1.0.

attribution.description: Who to credit for the site's data. The AppView drops a blank or over-long one.

derivedFrom.description: The dive the site was placed from, named only when that dive and its Map category are public.
